# hosting-pages publishing contract

This repository aggregates CI reports and deploys one constrained GitHub Pages
artifact. Tracked report files are raw inputs; the public site is produced only
by `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`.

## Branch responsibilities

- `main` contains the Pages workflow and maintenance scripts, `llms.txt`, and the
  existing `online-draft` report inputs.
- `yps-reports` contains only current Shiftori report inputs under
  `yps-crispy-carnival*` paths. Every update is a parentless snapshot commit, so
  report history does not accumulate.
- GitHub Pages combines both branches. It never publishes VRT baselines,
  `.report-meta.json`, stale Playwright data, or VRT images that are unrelated
  to a current diff.

Public URL paths remain stable:

- `/hosting-pages/yps-crispy-carnival/<pull-request>/`
- `/hosting-pages/yps-crispy-carnival-vrt/pr-<pull-request>/`
- `/hosting-pages/yps-crispy-carnival-vrt/branches/<develop-or-main>/`
- `/hosting-pages/online-draft/...`

## Shiftori writer contract

Shiftori workflows must use `scripts/publishHostingReport.mjs` from
`yn1323/yps-crispy-carnival`. The publisher:

- verifies that a pull request or branch still points to the tested source SHA;
- allows only the documented Shiftori destination paths;
- rejects symlinks and malformed report inputs;
- replaces one report and an optional branch baseline;
- writes schema-versioned source/run metadata and a deployment marker;
- retries concurrent updates with `force-with-lease` compare-and-swap;
- creates a parentless `yps-reports` snapshot; and
- dispatches the Pages workflow without putting credentials in a remote URL.

Do not restore direct Shiftori pushes to `main`, `git pull --rebase` publishing,
unconditional force pushes, or warning-only deployment timeouts.

## online-draft compatibility

The `online-draft` source repository is intentionally outside the Shiftori
migration. Its existing `main` writes remain supported, and its tracked report
tree is preserved unchanged. The Pages builder publishes only Playwright data
referenced by the current embedded report without deleting the raw inputs.

Do not require an `online-draft` source-workflow change without a separate,
explicit migration.

## Retention and publication safety

- Open Shiftori pull-request reports are retained regardless of PR number.
- Closed or merged Shiftori reports are removed after seven days.
- Branch VRT reports and baselines are replaced in place and are not subject to
  pull-request retention.
- Missing or invalid PR state/metadata must stop deletion rather than guessing.
- The public artifact must contain no symlinks or hard links, must pass the
  high-confidence secret scan (including embedded Playwright report data), and
  must remain below the configured 900 MiB hard limit.
- A source workflow may post a final report link only after its exact deployment
  marker is available. A timeout is a workflow failure.

## Operational maintenance

`yn1323/yps-crispy-carnival` owns the scheduled maintenance workflow because its
scoped `GITHUB_TOKEN` can read source pull requests. It runs this repository's
maintenance scripts, uses `HOSTING_PAGES_TOKEN` only for the hosted snapshot,
and rewrites `yps-reports` as a new parentless snapshot. A one-time history reset
of `main` removes accumulated history while preserving the current
`online-draft` tree exactly; do not automate that reset while an uncoordinated
legacy `main` writer remains.
